note: Schema negatives plus semantic negatives. Semantics are rules JSON Schema cannot express but L2 relies on; the checker fails the gate when one is violated.

cases.why: a manifest without endpoints declares a model nobody can call
the wire protocol set is closed at three; a fourth mode must fail, not warn
negative pricing would invert marginal-return decisions in the economy module
a string context window would break budget arithmetic silently
multimodal flags are required so callers never guess support
a free-form timestamp cannot be ordered against expiry
unknown schema versions must be rejected rather than best-effort parsed

validMutations.why: loopback http is legitimate for self-hosted local inference; the gate must not reject it
a third-party endpoint need not declare weights license

semanticCases.why: output budget above the context window is unsatisfiable and must be caught at declaration time
two endpoints speaking the same protocol make endpoint selection ambiguous
a self-hosted model without a weights license is a redistribution risk
